title: Render svg preview images in File Explorer is too slow

judgment.rationale: The report clearly says first-load SVG thumbnails are too slow, but it does not provide representative SVGs or a current-build confirmation, and SVG complexity heavily affects whether the main cost is WebView2 startup, file complexity, or both.
evidence: The report says 50+ SVG thumbnails render one by one at 4-5 seconds each on first folder open.
SvgThumbnailProvider.cs creates a fresh WebView2 instance, waits for navigation, captures a preview, and blocks synchronously for each thumbnail request.
No sample SVGs or current-version confirmation are attached.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for representative SVG samples and current-version confirmation before selecting a fix path.

fix_assessment.rationale: A thumbnail-pipeline fix is plausible, but sample files are needed before choosing between cold-start caching and SVG-complexity work.

issue_context.summary: Opening a folder with many SVG files is reported to generate thumbnails one by one at several seconds each, but the thread does not include sample files or a current-build confirmation.
known_information: The issue targets File Explorer thumbnail preview on PowerToys 0.100.2.
A screenshot attachment shows the scenario is about many SVG thumbnails in one folder.
Current SvgThumbnailProvider spins up WebView2 per thumbnail request.
inferences: Cold-start WebView2 cost is likely part of the symptom.
Representative SVGs are still needed to estimate how much file complexity contributes.
issue_context.analysis: This issue is not blocked on generic logs; it needs concrete sample files and current-version confirmation.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the issue body and attachment reference.
Reviewed src/modules/previewpane/SvgThumbnailProvider/SvgThumbnailProvider.cs and confirmed the provider spins up WebView2 per thumbnail and waits synchronously for capture completion.

information_gaps.information: Two or three representative SVG files from the slow folder, or a synthetic equivalent that reproduces the delay.
information_gaps.why_needed: The file content determines whether the bottleneck is mostly WebView2 startup or SVG render complexity.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please upload 2-3 non-sensitive SVG files through the GitHub web UI, or share a synthetic SVG set with the same characteristics that reproduces the slowdown.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same folder still reproduces the slowdown on the latest stable PowerToys build.
information_gaps.why_needed: The issue was filed on 0.100.2, and a current-build confirmation may rule out already-shipped improvements.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please update to the latest stable release if possible and confirm whether the same folder still renders thumbnails at the same speed.

comment.body:
Thanks for quantifying the slowdown as 4-5 seconds per SVG on the first folder open. To choose the right thumbnail-pipeline fix, please provide:

1. Two or three representative SVG files from the slow folder, or a synthetic equivalent that reproduces the same delay. Please upload them through the GitHub web UI.
2. Please confirm whether the same folder still shows the slowdown on the latest stable PowerToys build.

The sample files will tell us whether the main cost is WebView2 startup, SVG complexity, or both.

design_decision.reason: Representative SVG inputs are still missing.

confidence.rationale: Code path is clear, but the missing SVG samples leave the bottleneck ambiguous.
